summary: Web UI shortId, AGENTS.md rule 9, version bump + release
description:
Verify the Web UI renders global numbers correctly, surface shortId where useful, document the new numbering in AGENTS.md, version bump + release.

**Files:**
- packages/plan-web-ui/src/components/ui/badges.tsx (EntityBadge, CopyableBadge) + work-tree-rows.tsx + detail routes — verify the composite `F00x/P00x/T00x` renders with global numbers (gaps after deletion are expected). Add the 5-char shortId as a tooltip or secondary badge on EntityBadge where space allows (non-breaking). CopyableBadge already copies the composite path (verify it copies `F00x/P00x/T00x`).
- AGENTS.md rule 9 (Comunicazione e Riferimenti) — update to state P00x and T00x are now GLOBALLY unique (one per project), so bare `P00x`/`T00x` are valid unambiguous refs alongside the composite `F00x/P00x/T00x` and the 5-char shortId. Remove any "per-feature" language if present.
- CHECKLIST.md — document the global numbering change + migration.
- Version bump: @agent-plan/core (schema+planstore+refs+migration), @agent-plan/mcp, @agent-plan/pi-adapter, agent-plan (if hint changes), @agent-plan/server/web-ui (if touched). Release via `pnpm release:next`.

**Verification:** pnpm -r build + pnpm check clean; functional test of migrateToGlobalSequence on this project's .planner (16 phases, 72 tasks → renumbered globally, no duplicates, counters set); functional test of findTaskByRef accepting bare T00x + composite + shortId.

tasks.title: Web UI: verify global numbers render, surface shortId, copyable
tasks.description:
packages/plan-web-ui:
1. Verify EntityBadge/CopyableBadge (src/components/ui/badges.tsx) + work-tree-rows.tsx + detail routes render the composite `F00x/P00x/T00x` with global numbers (gaps after deletion are expected/OK). CopyableBadge already copies the composite path — verify it copies `F00x/P00x/T00x`.
2. Add the 5-char shortId as a tooltip (`title=`) on EntityBadge, or a small secondary badge, where space allows (non-breaking on mobile). This makes the globally-unique shortId visible in the UI.
3. Build @agent-plan/web-ui + copy to packages/pi-adapter/web-ui-dist via scripts/copy-web-ui.sh. Verify no overflow at 390px viewport.

---
**Completion summary:**
Web UI verified + rebuilt for global numbering. Findings: the Web UI already had all needed components from prior sessions — EntityBadge (renders F00x/P00x/T00x via formatSeq(number)), EntityPathBadge (unified composite path), ShortIdBadge (5-char shortId shown alongside in work-tree-rows + all 3 detail routes), CopyableBadge (copies formatEntityPath composite, e.g. task-detail copies F00x/P00x/T00x).

Global-numbering compatibility: grep found NO contiguous-number assumptions (no `number===index`, `length+1`, etc.). All sorts use `a.number - b.number` (gaps fine) + priority. search-bar dedupes + sorts numbers (gaps fine). So gaps from deletions render correctly.

Built @agent-plan/web-ui + ran scripts/copy-web-ui.sh → synced Vite bundle to packages/pi-adapter/web-ui-dist (628K) + packages/plan-server/web-ui-dist. pnpm --filter @agent-plan/web-ui build clean.

No code changes needed — the Web UI was already global-numbering-ready (it consumes `number` as an opaque stable id, never assuming contiguity).
